name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1931: Follow-on to the demo gate that hid a red J9 for seven versions. The trigger stays narrow on purpose, because widening it would block pushes on an environment the push did not break, which the original was careful about. What is gone is the SILENT skip: both branches now announce themselves, the file-unchanged branch counts how many commits have passed since the console UI last moved so the number grows visibly instead of the line disappearing, and both say how to run the demos by hand. We chose not to run this and this passed must never look the same.
